title: Your Liver Is Under Attack
hook: Fatty liver disease is not just about what you eat. The most dangerous window is while you sleep.

scriptContent.visual: Creator visible in near-darkness - only refrigerator light or a single lamp. Clock or phone shows 11 PM. No food props needed; the setting does the work. Hold the frame for a beat before speaking. No music intro - silence first.
scriptContent.audio: Fatty liver disease is not just about what you eat. A study out of Oxford, published in March 2026, found it is primarily about when your liver processes fat - and the most dangerous window is while you sleep.
scriptContent.text:
Not what you eat.
When you eat.
Oxford - Mar 2026

scriptContent.visual: Talking head under cool-toned blue light - reinforces the nighttime frame. Keep any graphic minimal and text-light.
scriptContent.audio: Here is the mechanism. Your liver's fat production is circadian - it naturally ramps up at night, while insulin sensitivity drops. Eating in that window overloads a system that was designed to be in recovery mode, not processing mode.
scriptContent.text:
Liver fat peaks at night
Insulin sensitivity - lowest
Circadian mismatch
